ripgrep.verification: Documentation reviewed; this example has not been execution-tested by useclis

Structured output.text: The --json flag emits a stream of JSON messages for search results.

Unattended use.text: A pattern and explicit path can be supplied as command arguments, without an interactive search interface.

Authentication.text: This local-file example needs filesystem read access; it does not use a service login.

Limitations.text: Search skips ignored, hidden and binary files by default.

workflow.title: Find TODO markers in a project as JSON

setup.text: Install ripgrep using the official instructions and confirm rg is available in your shell.

expected.text: JSON messages describe matching lines. Exit status 0 means a match, 1 means no match, and 2 indicates an error.

workflow.context: Run from the project directory you intend to inspect. The dot means that directory; default ignore rules still apply.

agent-browser.verification: Documentation reviewed; this example has not been execution-tested by useclis

Structured output.text: Use --json for output intended for scripts.

Unattended use.text: The default browser mode is headless; commands can be issued from scripts.

Authentication.text: Public-page reading needs no site login. Protected sites need separately authorized authentication state.

Platforms.text: Installation instructions cover macOS, Windows and Linux; Linux may need additional browser dependencies.

Limitations.text: Element references come from page snapshots; inspect the current page before choosing controls.

workflow.title: Read the title of a public web page

setup.text: Install agent-browser and its browser using the official installation instructions. Confirm browser launch is allowed for your task.

expected.text: The title command returns the page title as JSON; the final command closes the example session.

workflow.context: This example starts a named browser session and visits example.com. Use a fresh session name if useclis-example is already in use. It does not log in or submit forms.
